text:
maria: FYI — seeing 3x p95 latency spike in eu-dedicated pool since 11:22 UTC. Throughput down ~25%. Alerts firing for dedicated-sla p95 > 400ms. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/latency/eu-dedicated :eyes:
aj: hitting it too. Kernel-selection logs show frequent 'fallback-to-generic' entries and kernel churn on nodes 3/4
kai: KV cache eviction rate jumped ~10x around 11:21, lots of cache misses -> more decode work
devon: I pulled a profiler: flamegraph https://profiling.redwood/internal/shot/177200 - shows high CUDA memcpy and kernel-init stalls
samir: autoscaler placed pods into new hosts repeatedly — quota enforcement denied new slots then retried -> placement thrash
maria: hypothesis: quota misconfig on dedicated pool + noisy neighbor (one tenant running long-context batched jobs) causing scheduling churn and kernel selector to keep recompiling/choosing slower kernels
aj: can someone grep the quota events? `kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.kind=Node -A | grep quota`
devon: ran that — found repeated 'InsufficientResources' events with reason 'quotaExceeded' for group dedicated-eu-rai between 11:20:48 -> 11:34
sre-jen: I'm opening an incident ticket and paging infra. tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre. Incident channel: #inc-177200
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-177200 — paging oncall
kai: quick mitigation idea: bump quota temporarily for dedicated-eu and drain the noisy pod (pod id: noisy-encoder-7). I'll cordon node-3 then move its pods. Anyone object?
samir: +1 do it, but we need to capture heap/profile before kill
maria: capture traces first — devon take perf snapshot of node-3 and upload
devon: uploaded snapshot: https://profiling.redwood/internal/shot/177200/node-3. Also attached kernel-selection log snippet:
```
[11:21:05] kernel_selector: tried opt_k=sm_89_fast, fallback=native_generic
[11:21:06] kernel_selector: compiled kernel sm_89_generic, init_ms=120
[11:21:07] kv_cache: evict key=customer-42:size=1.2MB
```
aj: compile/init times of ~120ms per kernel + KV cache misses explains the p95 addition — when combined with placement restarts this becomes amplified
sre-jen: action items: 1) infra to increase dedicated-eu quota (samir/kai) 2) eng-runtime to push a quick kernel cache warmup and disable aggressive recompiles (aj/devon) 3) support to notify affected tenants and track SLA impact (maria)
kai: doing quota bump now, will cordon node after snapshot captured
maria: concise root cause hypothesis: quota enforcement + noisy long-context tenant -> placement churn -> kernel recompile + KV eviction thrash -> latency and throughput degradation. Details and timeline in INC-2026-177200
aj: assigning follow-ups: aj (kernel warmup PR), devon (profiling follow-ups), kai (placement/coordination), maria (customer comms)
maria: :thumbsup:
